## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] No passwords, access tokens, certificates, private data or generated build outputs committed
- [ ] Rust formatting and tests run, or reason for not running documented
- [ ] GitHub Actions Windows build and secret scanning pass
- [ ] File operations tested on disposable files, including conflicts and cancellation if touched
- [ ] Any user-facing limitations and regression cases documented
- [ ] No claim of Windows GUI or hardware validation without evidence

## Release impact

Does this change affect file contents, filenames, deletion, recovery, settings,
network paths, installer/signing, or third-party integrations? Explain the risks
and whether additional manual Windows validation is needed.
